text:
Ana Lopez: Hey team — prospect (FinHealth Inc) just pushed the SIG/CAIQ. They want SSO/SAML metadata, MFA enforcement docs, and an RBAC matrix for the POC. Can we assemble a minimal pack by EOD?
Mike Chen: I have the SAML metadata and ACS URL. Will upload a trimmed metadata XML and a short explanation. ETA 2pm.
Julia Park: I can do MFA enforcement note + screenshots of policy in Console. Need to confirm whether the prospect accepts adaptive MFA or requires strict platform-enforced MFA. @Ana any clue?
Ana Lopez: They said "MFA must be enforced for all users" in the questionnaire, no mention of adaptive. Treat as platform-enforced for now; we can surface adaptive as an extra.
Mike Chen: Pasting the example SAML entity snippet for doc: ```<EntityDescriptor entityID="https://accounts.redwood.ai/saml">...<AssertionConsumerService Location="https://accounts.redwood.ai/saml/acs"/>```
Mike Chen: I'll include ACS and IdP certificate thumbprint. Also a short step-by-step for Okta and Azure AD.
Julia Park: For MFA enforcement I'll attach two screenshots and this line for the questionnaire: "MFA enforcement is configurable at org level and can be set to required for all users; supports TOTP, WebAuthn (U2F), and we integrate with IdP-enforced MFA via SAML attributes."
Leo Patel: For RBAC matrix: we have the roles.csv (prod-read, prod-write, admin, billing) but the prospect asked about least-privilege mapping for service accounts. I'll produce a minimal mapping and show how to create service accounts with scoped permissions.
Ana Lopez: Good. Also include our SOC2/Audit statement excerpt that covers IAM reviews — they asked about periodic access reviews. Julia can you add the cadence and evidence (last review date + owner)?
Julia Park: Yes — add: "Access reviews run quarterly, owner: Security Ops (security-ops@redwood.ai), last completed: 2026-01-12". I'll attach the review checklist export.
sec-bot: Deploy bot: Uploaded file - redwood_saml_metadata.xml (visibility: limited).
Mike Chen: Uploaded RBAC_matrix_v1.csv and SSO_quickstart_for_Okta.md to the thread (links shared).
Ana Lopez: Perfect. Final deliverable checklist for the prospect: 1) SAML metadata + ACS/cert, 2) MFA enforcement statement + screenshots, 3) RBAC matrix + service-account mapping, 4) Access review excerpt, 5) Short POC runbook for provisioning SSO users.
Leo Patel: I'll draft the POC runbook steps for RBAC provisioning and include CLI commands and API snippets.
Ana Lopez: Can we target delivery by 18:00 PST today? Prospects wants this for their vendor meeting tomorrow morning.
Julia Park: I can finalize MFA docs by 16:30 PST.
Mike Chen: SAML and SSO quickstart done, pushed to thread at 14:05.
Leo Patel: RBAC mapping PR open, will merge after a quick review.
Ana Lopez: Thanks all — I'll send a consolidated ZIP to the prospect once everything is merged. Please add any compliance references to the thread before EOD. :thumbsup:
